fusions.name: Passing Grasp
fusions.desc: Closes around every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and you restore 6 health.

fusions.name: Firm Press
fusions.desc: A pressing strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. Anything struck moves 16% slower for 2 seconds, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pass It Round
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You restore 10 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Sure Hold
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
